**General advice (not from the job data)**  
Start by mastering SQL and basic statistics, then add a visualization tool such as Power BI or Tableau. Once you’re comfortable with data manipulation and descriptive analysis, move into machine‑learning techniques. Tools like R or SAS can deepen your statistical modeling skills, while knowledge of data‑warehousing concepts will broaden your ability to work with large, structured datasets. Practice on real datasets and contribute to open‑source projects to reinforce these skills.
